description: This file contains Python functions and scripts related to configuring and generating target specifications for Rust builds within a build system, focusing on ARM and other architectures, and handling features and compiler options.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_tune
methods.description: Generates LLVM feature flags based on tuning features and machine overrides, focusing on ARM-specific features.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_cc_arch
methods.description: Generates LLVM feature flags based on target compiler architecture options.

methods.name: llvm_features_from_target_fpu
methods.description: Returns soft-float feature flag if TARGET_FPU is soft.

methods.name: llvm_features
methods.description: Combines features from tuning, architecture, and FPU into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: rust_gen_target
methods.description: Generates a JSON target specification file for Rust compilation based on architecture, features, and environment variables.

methods.name: do_rust_gen_targets
methods.description: Python function that initiates target generation for the build system.
